title: Breaking with the band in Philadelphia
summary: Roy left over the rivalry among sidemen at the Metropolitan Ballroom in Philadelphia.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Yeah. I left the band for a while, because I couldn't stand those cats no more. All of a sudden, everybody was a star. We worked Atlantic City, Steel Pier, and we got through that all right. Then we went to... There's a ballroom, I don't know if it's called the

Metropolitan Ballroom in Philadelphia. That's where I broke with the band. I couldn't make it. Every night, a different cat would pick me to follow me home. "How come you don't give me more solos?" I said, "You didn't play no more than that when Gene was here." Because I used to run the band when Gene was there, when he'd go out or something like that. I played the drums, too, you know. So I said, "Man, this ain't for me." No, it was too much, man.
